scope: V8 deterministic transport tests using exact frozen5048 pool class, exact hosted dispatcher source, fake Node workers and ArrayBuffer stand-in for unavailable SharedArrayBuffer. No Wasm/Node/corpus timing.

results.name: FIFO keeps four physical slots, global queue order and original result order
production metadata snapshot isolates both immediately poisoned caller columns
held logical completions do not block FIFO draining or native source barriers
A and C forward unchanged logical assignments including multiple queued jobs
one worker failure rejects running and queued jobs and both public barriers
initialization errors reject readiness before any dispatch and all workers terminate
unexpected worker exit latches failure and rejects queued ownership

limitations: ArrayBuffer stands in for SharedArrayBuffer because the functions V8 surface does not expose native SAB.

These checks exercise promises, dispatch ordering, metadata snapshot isolation, readiness/failure and logical routing with fake workers. They do not establish real cross-thread data visibility or codec parity.
The hosted job must rerun the same deterministic body against native Node SAB and the actual frozen production module before any corpus timing.
